name: pointsman-effort
description: Phase 1 (shadow): attaches pointsman's existing route judgment to Claude Code's reasoning effort. OFF by default; SHADOW only records; ON may change a subagent loop's effort from its own first step, and the main loop's only when its prompt cache is already cold. Never changes a model or a subagent's role.

pointsmanPath.title: pointsman CLI path
pointsmanPath.description: Absolute path to the pointsman CLI shim. Empty uses $HOME/.local/bin/pointsman.

pointsmanHome.title: pointsman home
pointsmanHome.description: POINTSMAN_HOME override passed as --home. Empty lets pointsman resolve its own default.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout for each pointsman hook call; a timeout fails open (no decision, no rewrite).

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Print one content-free line per decision via $.ui.log for local debugging. Never includes prompt text.
